The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery

time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 3. Generic Malicious Code Certificate: The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. System Compatibility: The equipment offered by the bidder must be fully compatible with the existing Audio-Visual (AV) infrastructure already deployed in the Acade my. It is the bidder’s responsibility to ensure that all proposed hardwar e, software, control systems, and network interfaces can integrate sea mlessly with the existing setup without requiring major modifications o r additional components. Any incompatibility found after the contract is awarded will not be accepted. 2. Site Visit (Highly Recommended) All prospective bidders are advised to conduct a detailed site survey in all working days before submitting their bids. The purpose of this visit i s to assess compatibility of the proposed solutions, identify any potenti al challenges, and understand the spatial and functional requirements of the installation areas. Site visit will serve as a platform to clarify the scope of work, technical specifications, and site-specific requirements. No claims for extra payments will be entertained after contract award due to misunderstandings that could have been clarified during site vis it. (in view of the security of the campus, interested bidders must take prior approval for visit campus through email bvrao@svpnpa.gov.in or

contact on 040-24234430). The site visit may be requested on an y working day before the bid closing date. Bidders are advised to complete the site visit before participating in the bid and to carefully e xamine all terms and conditions. 3. Pre-Bid Meeting: A pre-bid meeting (online/offline) will be conducted on date and time m entioned in the bid document. The meeting will serve as a platform to clarify the scope of work, technical specifications, and site-specific req uirements. No claims for extra payments will be entertained after contr act award due to misunderstandings that could have been clarified dur ing the pre-bid meeting. Interested bidders who wish to attend th e Pre-Bid Meeting online or offline shall submit their request t hrough email at bvrao@svpnpa.gov.in or contact 040-2423443 0. 4. Responsibility for All Works: The selected bidder will be fully responsible for the complete execution of the project. This includes the supply, delivery, installation, configuration, integration, testing, and commissioning of all required A V and IT components. The scope also includes any civil works such as drilling or minor carpentry, any electrical works including power cablin g or sockets, and any IT or networking activities necessary to complete the project. The bidder must arrange all tools, safety equipment, manp ower, software licenses, and other resources necessary for timely and safe execution. 5. Certification of Product Support: The bidder must ensure that the quoted equipment is the latest model in current production and is not nearing end-of-life. Bidder must note t hat, it is the requirement of the bid that all quoted products will be sup ported with spare parts, firmware and software updates, and service fa cilities for a minimum of eight years after the expiry of the warranty pe riod. This support may be on a chargeable basis or under an Annual Ma intenance Contract.

6. OEM Authorization: An OEM Authorization Certificate must be submitted along with the bid . The certificate must confirm that the bidder is an authorized partner, dealer, distributor, or system integrator for the quoted products. It mus t further authorize the bidder to supply, install, and provide after-sales support for the said equipment. Failure to include this certificate may l ead to rejection of the bid during technical evaluation. 7. Warranty Terms: All equipment supplied must carry a minimum on-site warranty of 3 (t hree) years from the date of successful installation and commissionin g. During the warranty period, the bidder shall be responsible for atten ding to all faults and failures, providing technical assistance, and repla cing or repairing any defective hardware or software components. The bidder must also ensure the availability of firmware and software upda tes during this period. A dedicated point of contact must be assigned f or handling warranty-related issues throughout the duration. 8. After-Sales Service Commitment: The bidder must ensure that service support will be provided during bo th the warranty and post-warranty periods, whether on an AMC or char geable basis, as decided by the Academy. The maximum permitted do wntime for any equipment failure shall be four hours. In case of failure to restore service within this time, the Academy reserves the right to g et the system repaired through a third party, and the cost incurred will be deducted from the Earnest Performance Bank Guarantee (EPBG) or any outstanding payment due to the bidder. 9. Local Service Support: The bidder/OEM must have a fully operational service centre located in Hyderabad or elsewhere in Telangana. Proof of the service centre’s ad dress and contact details must be submitted with the bid. [Note: Kind ly provide the name and working mobile number of the Local S ervice Centre/technician].

10. Demonstration / Technical Presentation: If desired by the Technical Purchase Committee, shortlisted bidders m ust be prepared to conduct a technical presentation explaining the pro posed system, its architecture, key features, and implementation meth odology. In addition, a physical demonstration or Proof of Concept of cr itical components may be requested. The presentation or demonstratio n must be arranged at short notice and at the bidder’s own expense. 11. Post-Delivery Inspection: The buyer reserves the right to inspect and test the delivered equipme nt after installation and commissioning, even if the equipment has pas sed technical evaluation. Final acceptance will be granted only after th e system is found to be fully functional, complies with all specified requirements, and performs satisfactorily under real-use conditions. Th e bidder must address any deficiencies at their own cost. 12. Training: The selected bidder must provide hands-on training to the Academy’s designated staff members. The training must cover complete system o peration, user interface handling, basic troubleshooting, and regular m aintenance tasks. Training must be provided on-site and should include instructional materials such as user manuals and quick reference guide s. The objective is to ensure that staff can operate and manage the sys tem independently after handover. 13. MII preference: As per the Government of India’s Make in India ( MII) policy, all bidders are required to ensure accurate local value ad dition before declaring themselves as Class-I or Class-II local suppli ers. Certifications should not be submitted blindly for the purpose of g aining procurement preference. Please note that bidders offering impo rted products will fall under the category of non-local suppliers. They c an't claim themselves as Class-I local suppliers/Class-II local suppliers by claiming the services such as transportation, insurance, installation, commissioning, training and after sales service support like AMC/CMC etc. as local value addition.

14. MSE Preference: All bidders seeking MSE preference under public procurement policy are requested to ensure possession of a vali d MSME certificate. The bidder must be the actual manufacturer of t he offered product and must hold a valid MSME certificate unde r the manufacturing category. Merely acting as a supplier, trader, or reseller does not entitle the bidder to claim MSE preference benefits. MSE preference is strictly applicable only to manufact urers of the quoted product, as per prevailing Government of India guidelines. 15. Import of the above product or any of its components/acce ssories from countries subject to import bans or restrictions im posed by the Government of India (GOI), if any, is strictly prohi bited. 16. If any time (even after the installation of the goods/produc t), it came to notice that the product offered by the bidder is n ot as per the specification and necessary terms and condition ( including MII compliance and MSE compliance etc), the bidder/ supplier is liable to face the penalty or any other actions (deba rment/blacklisting etc) as per applicable rules amended from ti me to time. If after commencement of work the contract is terminated for unsatisfactory work, then securit y deposit shall be forfeited to the SVPNPA in addition to recovery of pe nalty. c)Penalty for delay in completion of the work shall be recoverable from

the bills of the vendor. CHECK LIST BEFORE SUBMITTING THE BID: 1. Ensure Submitting EMD, if asked. You can also claim for EM D exemption as per General Terms and conditions on GeM. Pleas e note that if you are claiming for EMD exemption under M SEs category, you must have valid Udyam Registration an d are manufacturer of the offered product or Service (Pri mary product/Service). For other methods of EMD exemption ki ndly refer to the General Terms and conditions on GeM. 2. Experience criteria: In respect of the filter applied for exper ience criteria, the Bidder or its OEM of the product offered in the b id {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, ma nufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to an y Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for number of financial y ears as indicated above in the bid document before the bid openi ng date. Copies of relevant contracts and delivery accepta nce certificates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid i n support of having supplied some quantity during each of the financial year. In case of bunch bids, the category of primar y product having highest value should meet this criterion. 3. Past performance: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or thr ough re-seller(s)} should have supplied same or similar Categ ory Products for 20% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three financial years before the bid opening date to any C entral / State Govt Organization / PSU. Copies of relevant contract s (proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financia l year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity suppl ied in the relevant financial year. In case of bunch bids, the categ ory related to primary product having highest bid value should m eet this criterion.

4. OEM Authorization Certificate. 5. MSEs preference: If the bidder wants to avail themselves of t he Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacture r / OEM of the offered product on GeM. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises and hence resellers offering products manufactured b y some other OEM are not eligible for any purchase preference. I n respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provi der of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offer ed product or service and Buyer will decide eligibility for purchase preference based on documentary evidence submitted, while eva luating the bid. 6. MII Preference: If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase pref erence, the bidder must upload a certificate from the OEM re garding the percentage of the local content and the detail s of locations at which the local value addition is made alo ng with their bid, failing which no purchase preference shall be granted. 7. Kindy attach ATC Acceptance Certificate. 8. Kindly attach BOQ compliance. 9. For BOQ and custom bids kindly mention offered product. 10. Kindly submit the Malicious code certificate separately. 11. Kindly attach proof of OEM/Bidder service centre Telang ana. .
